chalisa.do1: Mother Lakṣmī, be gracious and dwell in my heart.
Grant my heart's desire and fulfil my hope.
chalisa.so1: This is my prayer; with folded hands I plead:
make your gracious dwelling with me in every way. Victory to you, Mother Jagadambikā.
chalisa.cau1: Daughter of the ocean, I remember you; give me knowledge, understanding and learning.
chalisa.cau2: There is no benefactor like you; fulfil our hopes in every way.
chalisa.cau3: Victory, victory, victory to Mother Jagadambā; you alone are the support of all.
chalisa.cau4: You dwell in each and every heart; this is our special plea.
chalisa.cau5: Mother of the world, victory to you, daughter of the ocean; you do good to the humble.
chalisa.cau6: Great queen, I pray to you daily; be gracious, Bhavānī, Mother of the world.
chalisa.cau7: In what way can I praise you? Forget my offences and take care of me.
chalisa.cau8: Look towards me with a gracious eye; Mother of the world, hear my plea.
chalisa.cau9: You are the giver of knowledge, understanding and every happiness; our Mother, take away hardship.
chalisa.cau10: When Viṣṇu had the ocean of milk churned, fourteen jewels were found in the ocean.
chalisa.cau11: Among the fourteen jewels you were the treasure of bliss; you became the Lord's handmaid and served him.
chalisa.cau12: Whatever birth the Lord took, wherever he took it, there you changed your form and served him.
chalisa.cau13: When Viṣṇu himself took a human body, he became incarnate in the city of Avadh.
chalisa.cau14: Then you appeared in Janakapura and served him, your heart thrilling with joy.
chalisa.cau15: The indweller took you as his own, he who is known throughout the world, the Lord of the three worlds.
chalisa.cau16: There is no other power as mighty as you; how far can I go in telling your glory?
chalisa.cau17: Whoever serves you in thought, deed and word obtains the fruit his heart desires and longs for.
chalisa.cau18: Leaving deceit, guile and cunning, they worship you in many ways with their minds intent.
chalisa.cau19: I shall explain something more: whoever recites this with his mind intent
chalisa.cau20: has no hardship of any kind, and he obtains the fruit his heart desires.
chalisa.cau21: Protect me, protect me! Victory to you who end sorrow, who take away the threefold affliction and the bondage of worldly existence.
chalisa.cau22: Whoever reads this and teaches it to others, and hears it and recites it to others with his mind intent,
chalisa.cau23: is troubled by no disease; he obtains sons and more, wealth and riches.
chalisa.cau24: One who has no son or no wealth, who is blind, deaf, has leprosy or is in great want,
chalisa.cau25: should call a Brahmin and have it recited, and never let doubt into his heart;
chalisa.cau26: let him have it recited for forty days, and Śiva, lord of Gaurī, is gracious to him.
chalisa.cau27: He gains happiness and riches in plenty; he lacks for nothing.
chalisa.cau28: Whoever worships through the twelve months is blessed as no other is.
chalisa.cau29: Whoever recites it daily in his mind has no equal anywhere in the world.
chalisa.cau30: Why should I praise it in many ways? Let anyone put it to the test with his mind intent.
chalisa.cau31: Whoever keeps the vow and the rule with faith attains success, and love springs up in his heart.
chalisa.cau32: Victory, victory, victory to Lakṣmī Bhavānī; mine of virtues, you pervade all.
chalisa.cau33: Your splendour is mighty in the world; no one anywhere is as merciful as you.
chalisa.cau34: Take care now of me, who have no one; cut away my hardships and give me devotion.
chalisa.cau35: Forgive our errors and lapses; look on our state and grant us your darśana.
chalisa.cau36: In what way can I praise you? I have no great knowledge or understanding.
chalisa.cau37: Those worthy of your darśana are distraught without it; though you are there, they suffer heavy sorrow.
chalisa.cau38: There is no knowledge or understanding in my mind; you know all things in your own mind.
chalisa.cau39: Taking your four-armed form, now remove my hardship.
chalisa.do2: Protect me, protect me, remover of sorrow; quickly take away all fear.
Victory, victory, victory to Lakṣmī; destroy the enemy.
chalisa.do3: Rāmadāsa, ever meditating on you, prays with folded hands:
Mother Lakṣmī, turn a glance of mercy on your servant.
